title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user with local access to the affected host could obtain a live Splunk SOAR…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where a local user on the affected host can obtain a live session token or decrypted asset configuration. This occurs when another user initiates an App Editor debug action, which exposes sensitive runtime information to other local users.
